description: List messages with optional filters. Returns Twilio's paginated list; pass PageSize to cap.

DateSent.description: Filter by exact send date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use DateSentAfter / DateSentBefore for ranges.

DateSentAfter.description: Return messages sent on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

DateSentBefore.description: Return messages sent on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: list_messages
